title: Monthly Endpoint True-Up and Fee Billing for Sentinel Managed Security
content:
The Sentinel Managed Security monthly fee follows the endpoints enrolled under the subscription, counted once a month and billed in advance.

## Enrolled endpoints

Endpoints are enrolled when an agent is installed and retired when it is uninstalled. Servers and workstations are counted separately. Mobile devices are not endpoints on tiers whose service description includes mobile device coverage. The subscription's endpoint count is the number of workstations and servers enrolled with the Sentinel agent under it; each enrollment or retirement is recorded as a batch of one device class on one date for one reason.

Endpoint changes may be posted only while the subscription status is deploying, active, suspended or notice given. The status is read from the subscription's own record before the change is posted.

| Subscription status | Endpoint enrollments and retirements |
|---|---|
| Ordered | May not be posted |
| Deploying | May be posted |
| Active | May be posted |
| Suspended | May be posted |
| Notice given | May be posted |
| Closed | May not be posted |
| Cancelled | May not be posted |

## The monthly fee

On the tier's true-up snapshot day of each month the enrolled workstations and the enrolled servers are counted. The monthly fee for the next service month is invoiced in advance on the first day of that month. It equals the contracted workstation rate multiplied by the counted workstations, plus the contracted server rate multiplied by the counted servers, where the combined billed endpoints are never fewer than the contracted endpoints multiplied by the tier's minimum billed commitment percentage and divided by 100, rounded up to a whole endpoint; any shortfall between the counted endpoints and that minimum is billed at the workstation rate. The fee is rounded half up to the cent.

- There is no mid-month proration of additions and no credit for retirements.
- The first monthly fee is for the service month after activation.
- No fee is invoiced for a service month that begins after the cancellation effective date.

## Worked illustration (hypothetical rates and counts)

Contracted rates of 10.00 USD per workstation and 20.00 USD per server; 45 contracted endpoints; a minimum billed commitment of 90 percent. Ninety percent of 45 is 40.5, rounded up to 41 billed endpoints at the least.

| Snapshot count | Combined count | Shortfall billed at the workstation rate | Monthly fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| 40 workstations, 5 servers | 45 | None | 400.00 plus 100.00, which is 500.00 USD |
| 30 workstations, 5 servers | 35 | 6 endpoints | 300.00 plus 100.00 plus 60.00, which is 460.00 USD |

## Service months at the edges

| Situation (hypothetical dates) | Service month | Invoiced? |
|---|---|---|
| Activation on 10 March | April | Yes, the first monthly fee |
| Activation on 10 March | March | No, the activation month itself carries no monthly fee |
| Cancellation effective 15 June | June (began before the effective date) | Yes |
| Cancellation effective 15 June | July (begins after the effective date) | No |
| Cancellation effective 1 July | July (begins on, not after, the effective date) | Yes |
